description: This source file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure fault injection transactional state services, specifically within the Orleans framework. It introduces methods for adding fault injection transactional state support and configuring Azure Table storage for transactional state within dependency injection.

classes.name: TransactionFaultInjectionServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate fault injection transactional state configuration within Orleans.

methods.name: UseControlledFaultInjectionTransactionState
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use fault injection transactional state with singleton and transient registrations for related interfaces and implementations.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Configures Azure Table transactional state storage with optional configuration, registering storage factory and lifecycle participant services.
